Abecma.notes: Ends 2025Q4: from 2026Q1 BMS folds Abecma into Other Growth Products.

Adcetris.notes: Seagen U.S. and Canada net product sales (Takeda sells elsewhere), launch to 2023Q3. Ends at Pfizer's Dec 2023 acquisition; Pfizer's later worldwide line includes royalties and is a different scope, so not spliced.

Blincyto.notes: 2014Q4 = FY2014 (3) with Q1-Q3 nil inferred from the December 2014 approval.

Brukinsa.notes: Q4s derived from 10-K less nine months.

Cabometyx.notes: Exelixis U.S. Cabometyx line. Q4s derived from 10-K less nine months. Fiscal quarters end on the Friday nearest the calendar quarter end.

Cibinqo.notes: Pfizer first prints Cibinqo in 2023; 2022 quarters from prior-year columns, 2022Q1 derived (six months 6 less Q2 1).

Comirnaty.notes: Pfizer's line is direct sales plus BioNTech alliance revenue, relabelled over time (BNT162b2 -> Comirnaty direct sales and alliance revenues -> Comirnaty); kept as one series.

Elahere.notes: AbbVie series from 2024Q2; ImmunoGen's 2022Q4-2023Q3 is verified but kept out (2023Q4-2024Q1 uncitable).

Eliquis.notes: BMS's Eliquis row (Pfizer alliance; profits shared). Starts 2012Q2 with first ex-U.S. sales; 2012Q3 is a printed dash (0).

Enbrel.notes: Amgen's Total ENBREL (U.S. and Canada; Pfizer sells elsewhere), 2003Q1-2026Q2. Q4 2003-2010 derived from 10-K full year less 10-Q nine months (inputs in different filings, so the automated single-document check cannot match them; each read by hand). Immunex's 1998Q4-2002Q1 launch series verified but kept out (2002Q2-Q4 uncitable).

Esperoct.notes: Novo prints Esperoct only inside Rare blood disorders (footnote read at source in the Q2 2026 report).

Eylea.notes: Regeneron U.S. net product sales only (Bayer books ex-U.S.); EYLEA 2 mg line, EYLEA HD excluded. 2011Q4-2013Q3 read from release sentences.

Gardasil 9.notes: Product family: Merck prints only 'Gardasil / Gardasil 9' (quadrivalent + 9-valent). Series starts 2015Q1 when that combined line begins; the earlier 'Gardasil' line is a different definition and was not spliced.

Humira.notes: Abbott 2004Q1-2012Q4, AbbVie from 2013Q1 (spin-off). Starts 2004Q1: Abbott's 2003 documents print only U.S. and international Humira, no worldwide line, so no peak claimed from launch.

Ingrezza.notes: Ingrezza line; total product sales used only while Ingrezza was the sole product (to 2020Q2).

Jakafi.notes: Incyte U.S. net product revenue (Novartis sells ex-U.S.).

Januvia.notes: Januvia only (Janumet excluded). 2006-2009Q3 from legacy Merck (CIK 64978) filings.

Keytruda.notes: Keytruda (IV) row only. From 2025Q3 Merck also prints Keytruda Qlex (subcutaneous) separately; Qlex is not in this series, so the line keeps one definition. 2014Q3 from the Q4 2014 release's quarterly columns.

Krazati.notes: BMS series from 2024Q1 (post-close stub). Mirati 2022Q4-2023Q3 rows were verified but dropped: Mirati never reported 2023Q4, so no contiguous launch series exists. No peak claimed.

Kyprolis.notes: Amgen from 2013Q4 (Onyx acquired Oct 2013; Onyx's 2012Q3-2013Q2 kept out, 2013Q3 uncitable).

Libtayo.notes: U.S. series chosen as canonical: the only full-span product-sales series. Regeneron's 'Libtayo - Global' line exists only 2022Q3-2024Q4 and was not used.

Linzess.notes: AbbVie's Linzess/Constella total (U.S. + international) from 2020Q3, the longest contiguous series.

Livdelzi.notes: Gilead folded Livdelzi into Other Liver Disease until 2025Q4; its own line starts 2026Q1. Short series, no peak claimed.

Lorbrena.notes: Starts 2019Q3: Pfizer first prints a Lorbrena line in the Q3 2020 release; 2019Q3-2020Q2 from prior-year columns, 2018Q4-2019Q2 not separable. No peak claimed.

Mavyret.notes: Starts 2018Q3; earlier releases print only a combined HCV line.

Nurtec ODT.notes: Pfizer's Nurtec ODT/Vydura worldwide line from 2022Q4 (longest contiguous). Biohaven's 2020Q1-2022Q2 U.S. launch series verified, kept out; 2022Q3 uncitable.

Opdivo.notes: Opdivo (IV) row only; from 2025Q1 BMS prints Opdivo Qvantig (subcutaneous) separately and it is not in this series. Starts 2014Q3 with ex-U.S. sales before U.S. approval.

Otezla.notes: Amgen from 2020Q1 (acquired Nov 2019; 2019Q4 split). Celgene's 2014Q2-2019Q3 launch series is verified but shorter, kept out.

Ozempic.notes: DKK as printed. 2026Q1 is reported sales including a one-off US 340B provision reversal (reported 40,480 vs adjusted 27,825 DKK m), a large outlier. 2018Q2 derived (H1 264 less Q1 69).

Padcev.notes: Seagen U.S. net product sales, launch to 2023Q3. Ends at Pfizer's Dec 2023 acquisition; Pfizer's 2024+ worldwide line is a different scope, not spliced.

Pomalyst.notes: Pomalyst/Imnovid. 2013Q1-Q2 U.S.-weighted launch quarters. 2019Q4 is BMS's printed pro forma quarter, as for Revlimid.

Prevnar 20.notes: Product family: Pfizer prints only 'Prevnar family' (Prevnar 20 + Prevnar 13), from 2021Q3. Overstates Prevnar 20 alone, especially early.

Restasis.notes: Allergan, Inc. 2003Q2-2014Q4 (longest contiguous). Ends at the Actavis acquisition; Allergan plc and AbbVie later lines verified but kept out (split quarters).

Revlimid.notes: Celgene 2006Q1-2019Q3 (release narrative), BMS from 2020Q1. 2019Q4 is BMS's printed pro forma quarter (post-close stub plus Celgene pre-close revenue on BMS's basis), which differs from Celgene's own basis by <1%.

Rybelsus.notes: DKK. Ends 2026Q1: relabelled 'Ozempic pill / Rybelsus' from 2026Q2. 2026Q1 includes the 340B reversal.

Saxenda.notes: DKK. Starts 2016Q1 (2015 launch-year sales folded into other obesity care), so no peak claimed. 2026Q1 includes the 340B reversal.

Spikevax.notes: Moderna's product sales (COVID only until mRESVIA, May 2024), then the COVID line. Ends 2025Q2: from 2025Q3 the line also includes mNEXSPIKE.

Tresiba.notes: DKK. Starts 2016Q1, the first quarter Tresiba is a table line (earlier figures only in prose). Ends 2025Q4: from 2026 folded into Long-acting insulin.

Trodelvy.notes: 2020Q2 Immunomedics; 2020Q3 derived from Gilead's stated FY2020 (137) and full Q4 2020 (64) less Q2 (Q1 nil), approximate; Gilead from 2020Q4.

Ubrelvy.notes: AbbVie series from 2020Q3; Allergan printed only 2020Q1 and 2020Q2 is split by the acquisition.

Uplizna.notes: Amgen from 2023Q4 (Oct 6 close; Oct 1-5 not reported). Horizon/Viela history verified, shorter, kept out.

Vaxneuvance.notes: Starts 2022Q1: 2021 sales (launched H2 2021) appear only as a full-year figure, so no peak claimed. 2022Q1-Q3 from the following year's prior-year columns.

Velsipity.notes: Pfizer never prints Velsipity on its own line (FY2023 10-K lists it among Inflammation & immunology products; read at source).

Venclexta.notes: Starts 2018Q3, the first AbbVie release printing a Venclexta line (launched 2016).

Victoza.notes: DKK. 2024Q3 is negative as printed (US provision adjustment). 2026Q1 includes the 340B reversal.

Vraylar.notes: AbbVie series from 2020Q3 (longest contiguous). Allergan's 2016Q1-2020Q1 launch series is verified but kept out: 2020Q2 is split by the May 2020 acquisition and printed by neither issuer in full.

Vyndaqel / Vyndamax.notes: Product family (Vyndaqel/Vyndamax). Starts 2018Q1: Pfizer first prints the line in 2019; 2018Q1 derived as six months 2018 (72) less Q2 2018 (38), both in the Q2 2019 release.

Wegovy.notes: DKK. Ends 2025Q4: from 2026 Novo prints Wegovy injectable and Wegovy pill separately with no combined line.

Yescarta.notes: 2018Q2-Q3 are the U.S. line, the only line printed before EU launch.
